name: Gaiemmae
tagline: Shibuya in 5 minutes and Toranomon in 8 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥190,000 to ¥200,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 19 minutes to Otemachi, 14 minutes to Shinjuku, 5 minutes to Shibuya and 22 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. The station stands 32.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.3 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 32.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 32.1 m to 34.4 m, a difference of 2.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 23 clinics and 11 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is オリンピア会オリンピア眼科病院, about 13 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is Sanno Medical Center, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 赤坂見附→溜池山王, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 1K ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. 1LDK ¥320,000 to ¥330,000 and 2LDK ¥480,000 to ¥490,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. For One room, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Aoyama-Itchome, but Gaiemmae is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 6 minutes sooner than Gaiemmae. One-room rents run about ¥46,000 lower.

noiseSources: 青山通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
The nearest big road, 外苑西通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
